ruleBookInfo.author: @js:var m=src.match(new RegExp('导演：([^<]+)'));result=m?m[1]:'';
ruleBookInfo.intro:
<js>
function d(s) {
  return s.replace(/&#x([0-9a-f]+);/gi, function(_, h) {
    return String.fromCharCode(parseInt(h, 16));
  });
}
var m0 = src.match(/option value="0">\s*([^<]+)\s*<\//);
var m1 = src.match(/option value="1">\s*([^<]+)\s*<\//);
var name0 = m0 ? d(m0[1].trim()) : '线路0';
var name1 = m1 ? d(m1[1].trim()) : '线路1';
var xu = (book.getVariable('custom') != null && book.getVariable('custom') != '') ? book.getVariable('custom') : '0';
java.put('custom', xu);
var descM = src.match(/comic-desc[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<div\s/);
var dsc = descM ? descM[1].replace(/<[^>]+>/g,'').trim() : '';
result = '【线路列表】(右上角书籍变量输入序号刷新切换)\n◖0◗' + name0 + '\n◖1◗' + name1 + '\n当前来源◖' + xu + '◗\n------------\n' + dsc;
</js>
